name: Asaph Campground
note: Developed drive-in state forest campground (Tioga State Forest) along Asaph Run near Gaines. 10 sites with picnic tables, fire rings and non-flush toilets; four of them list a 30-ft max vehicle length, the rest 25 ft or less. No hookups, water or dump station. Must be reserved through the PA reservation system (since January 2024; on-site honor registration has ended). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: 'Effective January 1, 2024: The Asaph and County Bridge Campgrounds must be reserved through the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests Reservation website. On site (honor envelopes) registration is no longer offered.' Seven-night limit; check-in and check-out 3 pm.
field_notes.Fees: State forest rustic campground (a DCNR state FOREST program, not a state park): $10/night PA residents, $15/night non-residents, reserved through ReserveAmerica; 7-night limit.
field_notes.Sites: ReserveAmerica lists 10 Asaph Campground sites (001-010), all drive-in pull-in (not pull-through). Sites 003, 007, 008 and 010 list a 30-ft max vehicle length, 006 25 ft, 001 and 009 20 ft; 002, 004 and 005 list none (pads 15-20 ft). The Asaph loop's roadside, hike-in and equestrian sites are separate.

name: County Bridge Campground
note: Developed drive-in state forest campground (Tioga State Forest) near Grover, along a small stream. 15 pull-in sites, twelve of them listed for vehicles up to 40 ft; non-flush toilets, no hookups, water or dump station. Must be reserved through the PA reservation system (since January 2024).

field_notes.Booking: 'Effective January 1, 2024: The Asaph and County Bridge Campgrounds must be reserved through the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests Reservation website.' Seven-night limit; check-in and check-out 3 pm.
field_notes.Fees: State forest rustic campground (a DCNR state FOREST program, not a state park): $10/night PA residents, $15/night non-residents, reserved through ReserveAmerica; 7-night limit.
field_notes.Sites: ReserveAmerica lists 15 County Bridge Campground sites (001-015, Armenia loop), all drive-in pull-in (not pull-through), each within 300 ft of the stream. Twelve list a 40-ft max vehicle length, 001 and 014 30 ft, 003 25 ft.

name: Mounds State Recreation Area (Brookville Lake)
note: Indiana DNR, Mounds SRA on Brookville Lake. Campground set back from the lake, with shared beach access. --Claude

field_notes.Season: In winter only one or two loops stay open, water may be a single source, and most dump stations close.
field_notes.Fees: Electric $33 a night, Thursday-Saturday $40; full hookup $40, Thursday-Saturday $50. No out-of-state camping rate (the park entrance fee differs by plates). Indiana's rate page gives only statewide ranges; these are the booking site's prices for April 2027 nights, read 2026-10-31.
field_notes.Sites: Mounds only: 279 electric and 53 full hookup on ReserveAmerica. None under 28 ft. DNR's 388 electric and 62 full hookup cover all of Brookville Lake.

name: Breaks Interstate Park Campground
note: Breaks Interstate Park, run by the VA-KY Breaks Interstate Park Commission (developed area is on the Virginia side). 138 drive-in sites in loops A-D: primitive, electric+water, and full-hookup; paved loops. Reservable (Firefly); full campground Apr 1-Oct 31, Loop D open off-season. Loops sit on the wooded plateau, not on the water (the Laurel Lake lakefront accommodations are separate cabins). --Claude

field_notes.Season: The full campground is open April 1 to October 31; 'This year campground D will be open to campers that want to visit the park in the off-season.'
field_notes.Booking: Site-specific reservations online through the park's Firefly page ('Book Your Campsite Here'); check in at the campground store, late arrivals with a reservation find a packet on their site post, and those arriving after hours without one may call the ranger on call. $10 cancellation fee per site; cancel by calling (276) 865-4413 ext. 3201.
field_notes.Fees: $27 a night for a primitive site, $37 with electric and water, $41 with electric, water and sewer, plus tax; group sites $134. A cancelled reservation costs $10 a site. The park's campground page, read 2026-10-12 (the same rates were on it by July 2026; 2024's were $22, $31 and $37).
field_notes.Sites: 138 sites, from tent sites to full RV hookups; most wooded, grassy areas in campground D. Primitive, electric/water, full-hookup and group sites. Two vehicles per site.

name: Jamison Mill Park (Philpott Lake)
note: Franklin County Parks & Recreation campground on Corps of Engineers land at Philpott Lake, near Henry. Wooded lakeside setting with a non-motorized boat ramp and hiking trails; the electric sites sit beside the bathhouse, the overflow sites away from it. Cell reception is extremely weak. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Reserved and paid online through Franklin County Parks & Recreation's ActiveNet page (or 540-483-9293). The receipt carries the gate and bathhouse access code that entry requires, and the county asks campers to reserve before arriving because cell reception at the park is extremely weak; it does not mention walk-up camping.
field_notes.Fees: Non-electric overflow sites $20, water/electric sites $25. The county has announced 2027 fees of $26 non-electric and $34 electric. $10 cancellation fee (48 hours ahead); from 2027, $25 when cancelled under 10 days out.
field_notes.Sites: Water/electric sites 1-5 beside the bathhouse; non-electric overflow sites 6-11 away from it. 'Trailers longer than 30 feet are not recommended due to small sites.' Up to six people and two tents per site; extra vehicles park in the main lot.

name: Glen Maury Park
note: City of Buena Vista park (Glen Maury Park) on the Maury River. Lower campground: open grassy RV/tent sites without gravel pads (Rally Field, Riverside, The Island, Water's Edge), water and electric, no sewer, bath house and dump station. Upper campground: wooded gravel-pad sites at Hill Top and Oak Ridge, many full hookup, not recommended for rigs over 32 ft. Electric is 30 or 50 amp. Reservations by phone (540-261-7321); walk-ups may ask about availability on arrival. Campers may be asked to pay admission or move during city events. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: 'Reservations are accepted by phone only. Campers may also inquire about availability upon arrival.' Call 540-261-7321. Tent camping limited to 2 weeks.
field_notes.Fees: City of Buena Vista's camping page (2026 kiosk map on the same page), before tax: water & electric $70/night, water/sewer/electric $80 (upper campground only), tent (no hookups) $55; monthly $680 (not in the off-season). AT hikers $5/night, Passport America members $20/night, seniors 62+ $1 off. 'Taxes and fees not included.'
field_notes.Sites: Lower campground (Rally Field 13-46, Riverside 104-115, The Island / Water's Edge 66-93): open grassy sites, no gravel pads, water & electric, no sewer. Upper campground (Hill Top 1-23, Oak Ridge 24-53): wooded gravel pads, 27 of them full hookup; 'Campers or RVs over 32 feet are NOT recommended' there. No dry-camping sites.

name: Sugar Hollow Park Campground
note: City of Bristol park (~400 acres) along Beaver Creek. 75 electric (30/50-amp) sites, no tent camping (except Rhythm & Roots weekend), no cabins. Pay at entrance booth. Creekside trail; the mapped 'Beaver Creek Lake' is a TVA dry flood basin, not a standing lake. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Stays limited to 5 days, with a possible 5-day extension on approval. Check-in 3-8 p.m. weekdays, 10 a.m.-7:30 p.m. weekends; the registering party must show a photo driver's license with proof of current residence.
field_notes.Fees: $20 a night including water, electric, cable TV and Wi-Fi; $27 a night over Rhythm and Roots weekend. The city's page carries no date; read 2026-10-21 while it says the campground is open.
field_notes.Sites: 75 sites, 'most will accommodate all types of recreational vehicles'; each has a picnic table, charcoal grill and fire pit. Most have electric and cable TV hookups with access to water. No tent camping except Rhythm and Roots weekend.

name: Washington County Park
note: Washington County Park Authority park on South Holston Lake (lake is TVA, park is county-run). About 140 full-hookup (30/50-amp) RV sites, campers up to 42 ft, plus tent sites, 7 shelters, swimming beach, 2 boat launches; showers, laundromat, Wi-Fi. Open April 1 to October 31. Book online through the Park Authority's Firefly reservation page or the front booth; seasonal sites go by waiting list. The campground fills a narrow lake peninsula - outer-loop full-hookup RV sites back directly onto the lake (some with docks); inner sites have lake views. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Book online on the Park Authority's Firefly reservation page (credit card required for all rentals) or through the front booth, 276-628-9677. 'Temporary (overnight) camping has a maximum stay of 21 days in any thirty-day period.' Check-in 3-9 p.m., check-out by noon. Seasonal sites are assigned from a waiting list.
field_notes.Fees: Operator's 2026 rates (dated 01/2026) are quoted with the 7% lodging tax and 4% admin fee included: RV Standard $55.50 weekday / $61.05 weekend / $66.60 holiday, RV Lake Side $61.05 / $66.60 / $77.70, primitive tent $27.75-$38.85; i.e. $50-$70 for an RV site before tax and fee. $3.50 reservation fee; '$3 entry fee for ALL vehicles'.
field_notes.Sites: 'Size limit of campers are 10' x 42'' (2026 rules). RVs of all sizes up to that limit, from pop-ups to motor coaches; one camping vehicle and two vehicles per RV site; tents only in the separate tent area. Seasonal rates are published for site numbers 1-140.

name: Hibernia County Park
note: Chester County park (1,000+ acres) near Coatesville PA. RV-capable at the 19 Fiddler's Campground sites, which the county says take tents, small camp trailers and RVs (access depths 25-60 ft); the 20 Lake Campground sites are tent-only. No hookups, no dump station. Reservations online/phone or first-come self-registration; open weekends April through the second full weekend in November. Chambers Lake and Brandywine Creek are in the park but the RV-capable sites are wooded/inland. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Open weekends, April through the second full weekend in November.
field_notes.Booking: Reserve online through Chester County's rec1 catalog (an account is needed at checkout); group camping by phone at 610-344-6415.
field_notes.Fees: Every campsite $20 a night for Chester County residents, $30 for non-residents (the same on the 2026 Memorial Day and Labor Day rates). Group camping by phone.
field_notes.Sites: 39 campsites: the 19 Fiddler's Campground sites are each 'large enough to accommodate tents, small camp trailers, and RVs' (access depths 25 to 60 ft: #8, #15 and #17 60 ft; #3 and #19 50 ft), the 20 Lake Campground sites are tents only. No maximum vehicle length is published. Up to six people and two tents a site.

name: Sunfish Pond County Park
note: Bradford County park atop Barclay Mountain around 30-acre Sunfish Pond, near Canton PA (Leroy Twp). 38 electric-only RV sites plus about a dozen tent sites and primitive cabins; dump station, showers, camp store. Seasonal: May 9 - October 11 in 2026. A few RV sites sit along the pond. Park supervisor 570-250-5414. --Claude

field_notes.Season: 2026 dates: camping May 9 - October 11, plus the Friday before through the Monday after trout-season opening weekend.
field_notes.Fees: 2026 standard (RV, electric) site $45 daily, $200 weekly, $580 monthly, $900 seasonal; tent sites $25 daily; primitive cabins $50/night. Rates apply January 1 - December 31, 2026.
field_notes.Sites: 38 RV sites with electric only, plus about a dozen tent sites and primitive cabins. One camping unit per site.

name: Two Mile Run County Park
note: Venango County park (2,695 acres) on 144-acre Justus Lake near Franklin PA. Drive-in RV camping: 12 full-hookup + 28 electric sites (30/50-amp), modern showers, camp host. The lakeside 'water's edge' sites (loops E/F) are walk-in/primitive tent sites; the RV loops are set back east of the lake, so waterfront none. Reservations via the park office. --Claude

Booking: min stay 2 nights (reservations only; first-come sites take a single night)

field_notes.Booking: Call the park office (814-676-6116) in advance. Full-hookup sites and electric sites C-6 to C-9 take reservations with a 2-night minimum, up to a year ahead; electric sites A-1 to A-17 and C-1 to C-5 are first come, first served, as are the primitive B, D and E sections; T sites are reservable.
field_notes.Fees: Electric sites (A, C loops) $25 a night, $150 weekly; full hookup $35, $210 weekly; senior weekly $125/$175. Primitive drive-in sites (B, D, E) and the reservable T sites $20; water's-edge walk-in/boat-in sites $25. Off-season: electric $20 a night. Venango County's published fee catalogue (last modified 2026-10-07), read 2026-10-20.
field_notes.Sites: 72 campsites: 12 full hookup, 28 electric, 32 primitive with no hookups (seven of those walk-in tent sites), plus water's-edge sites that are walk-in or boat-in only. No lengths published.

name: Canyon Country Campground
note: Private campground at 130 Wilson Rd near Wellsboro (Tioga Co), on the East Rim of the PA Grand Canyon with a trail from the campground to the overlook level at Leonard Harrison State Park; close to the Pine Creek Rail Trail. Wooded sites with electric, electric/water and full hookups for rigs up to a 45-ft motorhome, plus primitive tent sites and glamping cabins; bath house with flush toilets and showers, laundry, store, dump station. Open April 15 - October 31; book online or by phone up to a year ahead. A $20 management fee per stay. --Claude

Fees: +$30/night each person over 2 adults and 2 children

field_notes.Booking: Online booking on the operator's Guesty engine, or by phone (570-724-3818). 'Reservations are accepted up to one year in advance.' Cancellation needs 30 days' notice and is refunded as a campground gift card.
field_notes.Fees: 2026 Camping Season Rates, all 'starting at', for 2 adults + 2 children or 3 adults: electric $50, electric/water $55, electric/water/sewer $65; primitive sites $43. Plus taxes, a $20 management fee per stay, extra person $30 a night, pets $30 per pet per stay.
field_notes.Sites: Operator: 'a variety of sites that will meet your needs whether you have a Truck Camper, a 45' Motorhome or anything in between.' No site count published.

name: Miller's Campground
note: Private family campground near New Alexandria (Westmoreland Co), 3 min from Keystone State Park. Many full-hookup sites, 30/50-amp; nightly/weekly/seasonal. No on-site water body. --Claude  Reservations by phone only (724-668-8589); no online booking — Hipcamp listing is "coming soon"/unbookable. Official site millcamp.com is HTTP-only (invalid HTTPS cert). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: 2026 rates: nightly full-hookup site $40 with 30-amp, $45 with 50-amp; tent $25. Weekly full hookup $175 plus electric, monthly $500 plus electric, seasonal $950-1000 a year.

name: Mitchell Lake Campgrounds
note: Small private full-hookup RV park (10 sites) near Cambridge Springs (Crawford Co), sitting just above 30-acre Mitchell Lake. 20/30/50-amp, water and sewer at every site; grass pads up to 50 ft, several pull-through. Daily/weekly/monthly, no tents, no restrooms or showers, laundromat; open May 1-Oct 31. Sites overlook the lake from above (not on the shoreline). Phone 814-398-2652. --Claude

field_notes.Season: The operator's home page says 'Open May 1 until Oct 31'; its booking site says 'Open May 1 until Oct 30'.
field_notes.Fees: Full-hookup sites $45 a night; open May 1-Oct 31; no restrooms or showers.
field_notes.Sites: The booking site's map lists 10 campsites, all full hookup on grass pads: 1-8 'Up to - 50'', 9-10 'Up to - 40''; several pull-through, the rest back-in.

name: Oil Creek Family Campground
note: Private family campground (54 wooded acres) near Titusville (Crawford Co); set back from Oil Creek itself. Big-rig friendly pull-throughs, 20/30/50-amp, water/electric and full-hookup sites. Not waterfront. Reservations by phone only (814-807-8005); no online booking system. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Dates are the 2026 season as published ('Our 2026 camping season is from April 17 to October 31').
field_notes.Booking: Reservations by phone (814-807-8005); a card holds the reservation. Memorial Day, 4th of July and Labor Day need three nights; the Haunted Halloween weekend needs two.
field_notes.Fees: 2026, 4 people: water + electric $45, full hookup $50; rustic $40; 3.99% card fee.
field_notes.Sites: Pull-through sites are the 'C' and 'F' sites on the map; the large 'F' pull-throughs 'will accommodate large campers'. Rustic no-hookup sites are separate secluded sites.

name: Rock Mountain Bible Camp
note: Christian camp near Susquehanna (Susquehanna Co) that runs a public family campground open to all (online nightly booking). Water/electric sites (20/30 amp on some, 20 amp on the rest), five with sewer; RVs to 40 ft on seven sites, most others 27-30 ft. Open May 15-Oct 12 in 2026, closed to campers July 19-31 for youth camps. Note: no-alcohol and conduct standards apply. On-site lake (RV sites not on it). --Claude

field_notes.Season: 2026 season May 15-October 12; 2027 announced as May 14-October 11. Normal campground operations are suspended July 19-31 for the camp's youth camps.
field_notes.Booking: Book online (ResNexus) or by phone 570-756-2200. Reservations for each season open online on November 1 of the year before (organized groups of 4+ sites from October 21).
field_notes.Fees: 2026: campsite with water & electric $37 a night, with sewer too $42; up to one family or 5 people per site. Day guests $8 each or $30 a family.
field_notes.Sites: RVs up to 27 ft: sites 1-6, 33, 52-54; up to 30 ft: 7, 8, 9, 48; up to 40 ft: 10-12, 41-43, 49. Sites 30-32 and 51 are tents or tent-trailers only.

name: Sunny's Campground
note: 115 acres, 5 lakes; mostly seasonal, with designated nightly and weekend lots. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: 2026 prices per unit, 2 adults and 3 children: water and electric $40, with sewer $44; holidays $8 more with a 3-night minimum. CampLife quoted $48.82 for one night in May and July 2027. Read 2026-10-31.
field_notes.Sites: 800 lots, of which 83 are nightly/weekend lots sold online; the rest are seasonal.

name: Flying Finn Family Campground
note: Mostly permanent (seasonal) sites and two club areas, with weekend sites for overnight campers. Big-rig friendly, 13-acre fishing lake, indoor pool. Campers and trailers only (no tents). Family-owned since 1979. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Daily rate $35. Visitors $3 a day, $5 a night. Seasonal sites $1,150 for May 1 to October 1 (family of four, water and electric included; air conditioning $165 a year or $5 a day). Mobile sanitation (tank pump-out) $8. Read 2026-10-30.
field_notes.Sites: Mostly permanent (seasonal) sites and two club areas, plus weekend sites; campers and trailers only, no tents.

name: Foxfire Campground
note: Most sites are seasonal; overnight campers get the water/electric rows and a few full-hookup sites. Sites 200-208 are grassy 'Creekside View' sites along Brokensword Creek. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Online through the park's Firefly Reservations page ('Book Now'). Check-in 3:00 pm, check-out 1:00 pm. All sales final, no refunds for weather; 48 hours' notice for an in-store credit.
field_notes.Fees: Water and electric $50 a night, water/electric/sewer $60 (2 adults and 2 children); 7 nights $265 / $325. Holidays $60 / $70 a night with a 3-night minimum. Firefly quoted the same $50 / $60 for a 23-ft Class C on weeknights in May, July and October 2027. Visitors $5 a person; personal golf cart $5 a day. Read 2026-10-30.
field_notes.Sites: 150+ sites on 33 acres, most of them seasonal; the overnight sites are the water/electric rows (about 55 on the operator's map) and a few full-hookup sites (PT-1, PT-2, N, O, 98-101). Pebble-stone sites, and grassy 'Creekside View' sites (200-208) along Brokensword Creek.

name: A1-Twin Valley Campground
note: Family campground off Apollo Rd SE outside Carrollton, with a pool, stocked fishing pond and rec room (Google reviews). No website of its own (the old domain is parked) and a Facebook page with no posts; phone from its Google listing. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $38 a night in November 2025 (Campendium review). --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Camper-reported: a Campendium reviewer paid $38 a night for a 2-night stay on site 90 (review dated November 16, 2025). The park posts no rate anywhere.

name: Atwood Lake Country Campground
note: Inland near (not on) Atwood Lake. Pool, three fishing ponds, mini golf, dog park; cabins and deluxe tent sites; monthly and seasonal long-term RV sites too. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Books online on Firefly (one night sells) or by phone; monthly long-term RV sites are a separate class.
field_notes.Fees: Firefly, one night, 2 adults, a 23-ft Class C motorhome: 30/50-amp water/electric back-ins (dump station for sewer) $35; full-hookup back-ins $40; full-hookup patio pull-throughs $44-49; deluxe patio pull-through $64 on weeknights (Tue 2026-11-10, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 alike), up to $74 on a July Saturday. A $3.50 reservation fee per booking (one $35 night: $38.50 due). Read 2026-10-30. The rates page's 'Starting at $50/night' is out of date against the engine.

name: River Trail Campgrounds II
note: On the St. Marys River between Van Wert and Celina; mostly permanent seasonal lots with a block of weekend sites. Pool, sandy beach on a catch-and-release pond, nature trail along the river. --Claude

Fees: +$5/night each person over 2 adults and 4 children

field_notes.Booking: Reservations by phone or in person only, not by email; a 1-night deposit holds a reservation, holiday stays paid in full. Check-in 11 a.m., check-out 1 p.m.
field_notes.Fees: 2026: back-in sites $40, pull-throughs $45 a night for 2 adults and 4 children; extra people $5 a night; holidays $1 more a night. Weekly $225, monthly $525.
field_notes.Sites: 260 sites, mostly permanent seasonal lots; the operator's map marks 39 weekend lots (30-49, 78, 79, 82-84, 190-200, 209-211), back-in and pull-through, plus monthly all-season sites.

name: Johnny Appleseed Campground
note: City of Fort Wayne, Johnny Appleseed Park. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Closed for the Johnny Appleseed Festival, 2026: Sept 13 noon to Sept 24 2:30 pm. 2026 closes Nov 2 at 10 am after the dog show week (Oct 26-Nov 2, $210 for the week, non-refundable).
field_notes.Booking: Submit the online form; the office calls for payment. First night ($30) is a non-refundable deposit. Site numbers aren't guaranteed. Only 2 adults per site. Check-in 2:30 pm, check-out 2 pm.
field_notes.Fees: City of Fort Wayne (Johnny Appleseed), 2026: RV sites with electric $30 a night, $600 for 28 days paid in full at check-in. Read 2026-10-31.
field_notes.Sites: Plus 2 overflow sites, 30 amp without water. 8 sites are used as pull-throughs.

name: Allegany State Park - Quaker Area (Cain Hollow)
note: OPRHP, Cain Hollow Campground in Allegany's Quaker Area (loops A-D). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked 1 day before arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. Only the primary occupant named on the reservation may check in.
field_notes.Fees: $20 a night for a site without hookups; electric +$9. Friday, Saturday and the night before a holiday +$4. Non-residents +$5 a night; $7.25 reservation fee. NY State Parks' booking site, sampled sites for a Tuesday and a Saturday in June 2027, read 2026-10-12 (this replaces the park's posted range, which spanned site types and weekends).
field_notes.Sites: 156 campsites in Cain Hollow loops A-D on ReserveAmerica (A 42, B 30, C 54, D 30), all back-in, listed equipment lengths mostly 26-33 ft; a few take 44-63 ft (site 098 63 ft, 069 55 ft). Allegany's Diehl Cabin/Campsite Trail (24 back-in sites, no electric) and the Horse Loop are listed separately.

name: Piseco Lake Campground (Little Sand Point Loop)
note: DEC (Adirondack): the Little Sand Point Loop of Piseco Lake Campground, hilly and wooded with conifers and hardwoods; many lakefront sites. Boat launch; motorboats allowed. --Claude

field_notes.Season: DEC's 2026 campground summary: closes Sep 7, last night the night before closing; ReserveAmerica's 2027 schedule runs to Sep 5, 2027 (Labor Day weekend).
field_notes.Booking: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.
field_notes.Sites: The Little Sand Point Loop of DEC's Piseco Lake Campground (98 sites in all per DEC): ReserveAmerica sells 56 campsites in the loop plus 2 group sites, 6 listed at 30 ft, 15 at 20 ft, 4 at 10 ft, the rest with no length. The other loop, Point Comfort, has 34 campsites including two listed at 40 ft and five 20-ft pull-throughs.
